name: swarm-dashboard
description: A live panel of coroutines and actor peers, read from the on-disk swarm state
doc: Coroutines and actors already persist everything that matters — <config>/coroutines/<team>/state.json and <config>/actors/<team>/*.presence.json — but nothing shows it, so the swarm is only visible through `CoroutineTool status` one team at a time. This mod reads both roots on a timer and contributes a panel: coroutine counts by state, the non-terminal ones with their worker and recovery attempts, and which actors have a fresh heartbeat. It also publishes the same data as the `swarm.state` service for other mods. Read-only: it never writes to the swarm directories.

commands.name: show
commands.title: Print the swarm snapshot as JSON
commands.doc: One shot, no panel: coroutine counts, non-terminal coroutines, live and stale actors.
